lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (Today's third customer... Judging by the outfit, is a courier?)

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Is this the café run by Demon Slayer?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Yes, it is. And you are...?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'm a courier sent from headquarters.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: One regular Americano, please.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Certainly…

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: But it's probably best not to mention Demon Slayer in front of other customers.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Headquarters should've informed you about that policy.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Sorry. I'll be more careful.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (I'd bet he asked the exact same question at two or three other cafés before finding ours.)

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: So... did headquarters send us something?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Your boss requested funding and supplies from headquarters for both the café and Demon Slayer operations.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'll move everything into your storage room.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: (So that's why the boss went to headquarters—to apply for funding and supplies. That was surprisingly fast.)

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Wow... this is really bitter. I've only ever had sweet coffee before.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Then next time you should try one of the other drinks on the menu.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: I'd be happy to recommend something.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Another shipment is arriving tomorrow, so I'll be back.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: By the way... is kopi luwak really made from cat poop?

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Uh... not exactly.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: More accurately, the coffee beans come from civet droppings after they've passed through the animal's digestive system, but the coffee isn't made directly from poop.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Besides, we don't even serve kopi luwak here.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Though the coffee at that café across the street—"Whatever"—smells as awful as cat poop.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Their desserts are really good, though.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: True.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: But they don't care about making proper coffee at all.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: Honestly, I hope they go out of business sooner rather than later.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'd better get going. I still have more deliveries to make.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: See you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Avril
lines.text: We'll be looking forward to your next visit.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I heard you can make Mocha Latte here?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Not unlocked yet, huh... Well, get everything ready and I'll come back next time.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I'll be heading off then. Don't forget to prepare the ingredients for Mocha Latte!

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: I hope to finally try it next time I visit.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Did you manage to get that Mocha Latte I asked about last time?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Excellent! Finally! Here, this is your reward!

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Did you manage to get that Mocha Latte I asked about last time?

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: Still not ready, huh... Well, keep working on it. I'll check back next time.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 这是今天的物资。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 哦，谢谢。今天想要一杯什么样的咖啡呢。

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 请帮我推荐一杯不是泥水口味的。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 我可以为您提供一杯甜口的咖啡。但我们店的咖啡不是泥水呢。

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 我想开个玩笑，抱歉冒犯了。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 哈哈哈，原来是开玩笑啊，我还以为是开玩笑呢。

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 总之我现在有点疲惫了，需要补充一些咖啡因。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 好的，那么就由我来为您推荐一杯呢。

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 嗯，这杯不错，比昨天那杯好喝多了。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 谢谢夸奖，那以后就多来光顾呀。

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 对了，总部那边说最近可能会派人来视察咖啡店。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 视察？我这边没什么问题吧……

lines.speaker: Mysterious Courier
lines.text: 放心，就是例行检查。我先走了，还有货要送。

lines.speaker: 艾薇儿
lines.text: 慢走，路上小心。
